title: Import cycle between 2 modules
why: Modules in a cycle can't be understood, tested or changed one at a time.
fix: Move the shared piece into its own module, or invert one dependency.

title: Layer cycle between a, b
evidence: b → a (1 edges, back edge): src/b/two.ts → src/a/one.ts; a → b (1 edges): src/a/one.ts → src/b/two.ts
why: Layers that depend on each other are no longer layers.
fix: Remove the back edges listed first; they are the cheapest to cut.

title: src/main.ts exports 1 unused symbol
why: Exports nobody uses are dead weight and widen the module's surface.
fix: Remove them, or drop the export keyword if they are used locally.
